answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 158 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is recorded against the vault challenge, the summit audit can replay the lotus history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3716 identities would post 1596 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
